document: 万科企业股份有限公司发行股份购买资产暨关联交易预案（修订稿）
verification: The issuer records a suspension beginning 2015-12-18 13:00, followed by the restructuring suspension on 2015-12-21. The endpoint queried at 2016-01-04 returns only the later 2017-07-17 event for 000002. Filtering latest rows by event start/end therefore cannot reconstruct the earlier suspension. This primary disclosure is an independent falsification of the complete historical snapshot claim.
